summary: Independent review reproduced the remaining hybrid-Mamba extra-buffer failure on the recorded base and verified the exact candidate fixes it. The base left an already committed chunk-boundary node unbacked when a short final extend produced no new Mamba checkpoint. The candidate re-walks the request's tree-owned cache_protected_len at finalization; exact-commit tests then backed up both the FULL KV payload and Mamba sidecar without changing native code. Current base already performs the final non-chunked walk for ordinary attention; the candidate addresses the remaining Mamba extra-buffer boundary. The exact reported 256K hybrid-KDA model and MooncakeStore restart/loadback topology were unavailable, so those deployment-specific paths remain unqualified rather than being used as proof.

remaining_limitations: The reported 256K hybrid-KDA model and weights were unavailable, so that exact architecture and context length were not executed.

No two-process MooncakeStore deployment was available; storage persistence across server restart/loadback was not measured. Verification reached the real HiCache host-backup transition and materialized both FULL and Mamba host payloads.
No independent model-output numerical comparison was run because the candidate changes Python cache-finalization bookkeeping only, not model-forward or kernel arithmetic.

No native source changed. repository-environment.json declares native=null, so no native rebuild was applicable; the pre-existing AITER extension path was recorded but is not evidence for the candidate fix.
NUMA balancing was enabled on the node and AITER emitted its standard performance warning; node-wide state was not changed.
